name: Hue White and Color Ambiance A60 E27 smart bulb - 1100
hub: Hue Bridge or Hue Bridge Pro (Bluetooth direct within range, no bridge)

ecosystems.ecoNote: Zigbee via Hue Bridge; Matter when bridged by Hue Bridge Pro.

visualNotes: Classic A60 pear bulb, 60 mm wide and 112 mm tall, with an opal white frosted dome that glows evenly and a short white neck into an E27 base. No visible buttons, LEDs or rings: the whole dome is the emissive part, so give it its own emissive material. Hero colour is frosted white.
descPL: Żarówka E27 z białym i kolorowym światłem, sterowana przez mostek Hue.
notes: Official PL store price 292.99 zł. Lumens from the product name (1100); some EU listings say 1055 lm.

name: Hue White and Color Ambiance GU10 smart spotlight
hub: Hue Bridge or Hue Bridge Pro (Bluetooth direct within range)

ecosystems.ecoNote: Zigbee via Hue Bridge; Matter when bridged by Hue Bridge Pro.

visualNotes: Round GU10 spotlight, 50 mm across and 57 mm long, with a white plastic body and a flat frosted front lens that glows, plus two bi-pin contacts at the back. The emissive part is the front lens. No logos or buttons visible.
descPL: Punktowa żarówka GU10 z białym i kolorowym światłem do oświetlenia akcentowego.
notes: Official PL store price 319 zł. Watts (about 4.2) and lumens (about 350) are approximate from EU listings, verify before use. Dims from the PL spec sheet.

name: Hue Bridge Pro

ecosystems.ecoNote: Hue hub for up to 150 lights; Philips page wording on Matter is unclear, verify.

visualNotes: Near-square black rounded box, 92 x 92 mm and only 26 mm tall, with a flat top and soft corners. Ethernet and power jacks are on the back, with no display. Matte black plastic with a slight sheen.
descPL: Mostek Hue Pro z Ethernetem i Zigbee, centrum całego oświetlenia Hue.
notes: x-kom price 344 zł used. The official Philips PL store lists 679.99 zł (not used). Hub, so no hub needed.

name: Hue Play Gradient Lightstrip 55 inch
hub: Hue Bridge or Hue Bridge Pro, plus Hue Play HDMI Sync Box (sold separately)

ecosystems.ecoNote: Needs a Hue bridge and the HDMI sync box for the screen-sync gradient.

visualNotes: Thin black strip about 2.16 m long and roughly 17 x 16 mm in section, with a row of individually lit colour LEDs along one face that points at the TV's back wall. It is held by brackets on the back of the TV, with a 24 V power brick in the cable run and the HDMI sync box separate. The LED row is the emissive part.
descPL: Taśma za telewizor z gradientem barw, synchronizowana z obrazem na ekranie.
notes: 55 inch version (the one x-kom sells at 865 zł). 65 inch and 75 inch also exist (official PL 75 inch 1228.99 zł, 65 inch clearance). Length 2164 mm from the official PL spec; width and height taken from the 65 inch spec. Watts from the 65 inch spec.

name: Hue White and Color Ambiance Lightstrip Plus V4 2 m base
hub: Hue Bridge or Hue Bridge Pro (Bluetooth direct within range)

ecosystems.ecoNote: Hue bridge for Zigbee; extendable up to 10 m with extension strips.

visualNotes: Flexible continuous strip, 2 m long and about 10 to 15 mm wide, with SMD LEDs under a white silicone cover; it is not segmented. The 20 W power supply sits in the cable run at one end, and the strip is cut-to-length only at marked points. The emissive part is the whole top face.
descPL: Elastyczna taśma LED 2 m, biała i kolorowa, do podświetlenia mebli i ścian.
notes: PL price from elecena.pl shop page (322.52 zł). Dims from the UK spec sheet; width approximate. Official PL page for this product returns 404, so the official slug was not found.

name: Hue Tap dial switch
hub: Hue Bridge or Hue Bridge Pro (Zigbee)

ecosystems.ecoNote: Controls Hue lights through the bridge; not a Matter device.

visualNotes: Square white wall switch about 60 mm across and 20 mm proud of the wall, with a raised rotary dial ring in the middle for dimming and a set of separate tap buttons around it. It mounts on an 80 mm square plate with adhesive or screws, with the battery on the back. No visible LED.
descPL: Bezprzewodowy przełącznik ścienny z pokrętłem do ściemniania i przyciskami scen.
notes: White version at the official PL price (249 zł). Black version also exists (Komputronik lists 219 zł, not verified). Dims from the PL spec sheet (body 60 x 60 x 20 mm, 80 mm plate), approximate.

name: Govee RGBIC LED Strip Light M1 (Matter)

ecosystems.ecoNote: Matter over Wi-Fi. Apple Home and Google Home need a home hub (HomePod, Apple TV, Nest Hub or HA) for remote control.

visualNotes: Flexible 2 m RGBIC strip about 10 mm wide with individual LED chips under a silicone sleeve, 60 LEDs per metre. The kit ships as a round black box with the strip coiled inside and a DC power adapter at the start of the run. The emissive part is the LED row along one face.
descPL: Elastyczna taśma RGBIC 2 m z obsługą Matter, każdy segment może mieć inny kolor.
notes: PRICE IS AN ESTIMATE: no Polish shop price found (EU launch EUR 79.99, UK sale GBP 39.99, desertcart.pl 828 zł looks unreliable). Model confusion: the Matter kit is H61E0, the base M1 is H61E1 without Matter. Width and dims approximate. Photo is a 300 px cached image of the kit.

name: Govee Floor Lamp 2

ecosystems.ecoNote: Matter listed for Google, Apple, Alexa and SmartThings; reports of fiddly setup. Needs 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi.

visualNotes: Tall floor lamp about 1.5 m high, with a slim upright post, a light head at the top and a round weighted base. Lighting is RGBIC in the post and the base, in black or silver finish. Design details such as the head shape and diffuser are NOT verified, so check a reference photo before modelling.
descPL: Stojąca lampa podłogowa RGBIC z Wi-Fi i Matterem, o wysokości około 1,5 m.
notes: PRICE IS AN ESTIMATE: EUR 149.90 (Alza AT) x 4.3. Design details unverified, since the spec sources conflict (RGBIC vs plain RGB, and the head shape). Model code H607C. No usable photo: the only cached image was too small, so skipped. Floor Lamp 2 Pro is a newer, different model.

name: DIRIGERA hub for smart products, white smart
